capacitance.description: Node-resolved FEniCSx capacitance matrix from single-node basis-field cross energies plus an all-bias energy check, with the core treated as dielectric.

capacitance_network.matrix_extraction: basis-field cross-energy with exact reflected-field interpolation

notes: Axisymmetric r-z model.
HV flow holes are omitted from this first-order field model.
Bias plates are solid discs extending to the axis; they have no center ID.
The core is represented as separate axial pieces divided by the solid bias plates.
All HV conductors are held at the full bias voltage for local field screening.
Current electrostatic solver treats conductors as equipotential boundaries; conductivity and permeability fields are carried for future RF/quasi-static backends.
Ground plate OD is intended to contact the ground tube ID when the tube is included.
HV plate rounding applies to the outer radial edge; ground plate rounding applies to the inner radial edge.

excitation_states.title: B  Mirrored neighbors together
excitation_states.solution_source: linear reconstruction from exact mirror basis fields

bias_to_ground_comparison.interpretation: The middle-only diagonal includes mutual capacitance to every bias plate held at zero volts. The three-state polarization subtraction removes those terms. The one-bias geometry provides an independent case with no bias-to-bias mutual capacitance to subtract.

cg_matrix_plate_count_comparison.repeating_note: Two bias plates have no interior node and three bias plates have only one interior node, so the repeating-interior assumption adds no equivalence beyond exact reflection for this comparison.
